delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONSIDERATION. The receiving party shall protect disclosed information for a period of three years. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing or until the confidential information is no longer confidential, whichever occurs first. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
